title: 第21章 以己之道还施彼身第22章 人找死的时候挡都挡不住
content_zh:
陆鸣不断后退，并且朝着陆宸怒吼：“混蛋，你已经废了我一条胳膊，你还想怎么样？”
陆宸冷笑道：“我想怎么样，你不是都已经看到了吗？”
“不，不～，你不能废了我，我不能失去武道。”
陆鸣嘶吼道。
陆宸道：“现在知道怕了，你当初欺负战弟的时候干嘛去了？”
砰！
想到当日陆宸对他说的话，陆鸣彻底失去了往日的嚣张气焰，砰的一声跪在陆宸的面前。
陆鸣央求道：“陆宸，我错了，请你念在我是你堂兄的份上饶过我这一回，我以后再也不敢了。”
陆宸讥笑道：“这会知道我是你堂弟了，当初你怎么不知道我和战弟是你堂弟，对我们好点？下手轻点？”
陆鸣被怼得无言以对，他也不知道陆宸装死啊，要不然就是借他几个胆子，他也不敢在陆宸面前放肆。
见陆鸣沉默，陆宸冷漠道：“你也别求饶了，求我，我也不会放过你，你下辈子就好好忏悔去吧。”
话音未落，陆宸一脚踹向陆鸣。
不过，陆鸣似乎并不想就这么认命，因为他已经看出陆宸虽然没被废，武道却跌落到了一重武士境。
他现在的武道境界为三重武士境，即便陆宸天赋妖孽，有跨境战斗的实力，他也能一搏。
“混蛋，我跟你拼了！”
一声怒吼，面目狰狞的陆鸣纵身飞起，集所有力量于右手，接着使出了必杀技：天罡拳。
见状，陆宸冷笑道：“垂死挣扎而已！”
话落，陆宸运转阴阳典将灵力汇聚于脚底，直接来了一个反身踹，一脚踹向陆鸣的小腹。
不过，就在陆鸣被废的瞬间，一道魁梧的身影出现在了陆鸣的身前，只见他伸手一托，将陆宸送了回去。
是陆狂，在这最后关头，他出手救下了陆鸣。

陆鸣被救了，但在被废边缘走了一遭，他眼神恐惧的躲在了陆狂的身后，整个人吓得瑟瑟发抖。
陆宸有些不悦道：“四叔，你为什么拦着我，不让我废了这玩意。”
陆狂道：“宸儿，他上次伤了战儿，还欺负你，你揍他是应该的，哪怕再废他一条胳膊四叔也不阻止。”
“不过，你如果要废了他，出手稍微重了些，毕竟他是你堂兄，今天你就看在四叔的份上饶了他这一次吧。”
陆狂是除了陆毅外，陆宸唯一尊重的人，见陆狂都出面了，陆宸也不好再对陆鸣下狠手。
陆宸看向陆鸣道：“你给我记住，这是第一次，也是最后一次，你要再招惹我和战弟，我一定废了你。”
陆鸣这时候不敢反驳，只能压抑着自己的怨恨，捂着被陆宸震碎的右手逃出了陆宸的小院。
等到陆鸣走了，陆狂走到陆宸面前，笑着说道：“宸儿，可以啊，经过重塑，你的战力比以前更强了。”
陆宸撇嘴道：“四叔，别以为夸奖我几句，我就不生气了。”
content_en:
Lu Ming kept retreating and yelled at Lu Chen: "Asshole, you have already disabled one of my arms, what else do you want?"
Lu Chen sneered and said, "What do I think? Haven't you already seen it?"
"No, no~, you can't destroy me, I can't lose my martial arts."
Lu Ming roared.
Lu Chen said: "Now that I know I'm afraid, what were you doing when you bullied Brother Zhan?"
Bang!
Thinking of what Lu Chen said to him that day, Lu Ming completely lost his previous arrogance and knelt down in front of Lu Chen with a bang.
Lu Ming begged: "Lu Chen, I was wrong. Please forgive me this time because I am your cousin. I will never dare to do it again in the future."
Lu Chen sneered and said: "Now you know that I am your cousin. Why didn't you know that Brother Zhan and I were your cousins at the beginning? Be nice to us? Be gentle?"
Lu Ming was speechless. He didn't know that Lu Chen was pretending to be dead. Otherwise, even if he borrowed some courage from him, he wouldn't dare to be presumptuous in front of Lu Chen.
Seeing Lu Ming's silence, Lu Chen said coldly: "Don't beg for mercy. Please beg me. I won't let you go. You should repent in your next life."
Before he finished speaking, Lu Chen kicked Lu Ming.
However, Lu Ming didn't seem to want to just accept his fate, because he had already seen that although Lu Chen was not abolished, his martial arts had fallen to the first level of the warrior realm.
His current martial arts realm is the third-level warrior realm. Even if Lu Chen is gifted as a monster and has the strength to fight across borders, he can still give it a try.
"Asshole, I'll fight you!"
With a roar, the ferocious-looking Lu Ming flew up, concentrated all his strength on his right hand, and then used his special move: Tiangang Fist.
Seeing this, Lu Chen sneered: "It's just a dying struggle!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Chen used the Yin and Yang Code to gather spiritual power on the soles of his feet, and then kicked Lu Ming directly in the lower abdomen.
However, at the moment when Lu Ming was deposed, a burly figure appeared in front of Lu Ming. He stretched out his hand and sent Lu Chen back.
It was Lu Kuang. At this last moment, he took action to save Lu Ming.
Lu Ming was rescued, but once he was on the verge of being crippled, he hid behind Lu Kuang with fearful eyes, and his whole body was trembling with fear.
Lu Chen was a little displeased and said, "Fourth uncle, why are you stopping me from destroying this thing?"
Lu Kuang said: "Chen'er, he hurt Zhan'er last time and bullied you. It's right for you to beat him. Even if he cripples one of his arms, Uncle Fourth will not stop him."
"However, if you want to destroy him, you should be a little harsher. After all, he is your cousin. Today, for the sake of your fourth uncle, please spare him this time."
Lu Kuang was the only person Lu Chen respected besides Lu Yi. Seeing that Lu Kuang had come forward, Lu Chen could no longer be cruel to Lu Ming.
Lu Chen looked at Lu Ming and said, "Remember, this is the first and last time. If you ever provoke Brother Zhan and me again, I will definitely destroy you."
Lu Ming did not dare to refute at this time, so he could only suppress his resentment, and ran out of Lu Chen's courtyard holding his right hand that was shattered by Lu Chen.
After Lu Ming left, Lu Kuang walked up to Lu Chen and said with a smile: "Chen'er, it's okay. After reshaping, your combat power is stronger than before."
Lu Chen pouted and said, "Fourth uncle, don't think that if you praise me a few words, I won't be angry."
